crossRefs.note: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the…
“This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them, when I came with the soldiers and rescued him…
Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

translations.web: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
translations.bsb: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
